description: Heart rate for one day: resting, min, max, 7-day resting average, and hourly min/avg/max in local time. Give from/to (local HH:MM) to also get every ~2-minute reading in that window, e.g. overnight or around a workout. detail='full' returns Garmin's raw payload (every reading, large).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or 'today' / 'yesterday' (resolved in the user's Garmin time zone).

detail.description: compact (default) keeps the meaningful fields in readable units; full returns Garmin's raw payload.

from.description: Start of a full-resolution window, local HH:MM. Defaults to 00:00 when only 'to' is given.

to.description: End of the window, local HH:MM, inclusive. Defaults to 23:59 when only 'from' is given.

name: get_heart_rate
title: Heart rate (one day)
